abstract: Calculates catering utility demands and diplomatic hospitality water allocations
system_message:
You are Hospitality operations manager (HOM). The Hospitality operations manager (HOM) monitors diplomatic event logistics, focusing on calculating catering utility demands and diplomatic hospitality water allocations alongside banquet operational parameters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Calculates catering utility demands and diplomatic hospitality water allocations（HOSP）
information_points.content:
HOM-HOSP-5P0：For Weser Estuary Exhibition Complex, the catering and sanitation resource plan projects a potable hospitality water allotment of 550 m3 across the 4-day summit schedule covering state banquet kitchens and delegate hospitality suites.
HOM-HOSP-2R0：According to the catering and sanitation resource plan for state banquet kitchens and delegate hospitality suites, the potable hospitality water allotment for North Sea Maritime Congress Center is projected at 550 m3 in total estimated municipal potable water consumption across the 4-day summit schedule.
HOM-HOSP-5SA：The catering and sanitation resource plan allocates Bremenhaven Atlantic Forum a potable hospitality water allotment of 550 m3 across the 4-day summit schedule for its state banquet kitchens and delegate hospitality suites.

information_points.title: Simultaneous seating service（BANQ）
information_points.content:
HOM-BANQ-N7Y：Operational timing protocols for the main state dinner gala hall indicate that North Sea Maritime Congress Center maintains a banquet table turnover speed of 55 min to reconfigure meal courses for 800 delegates.
HOM-BANQ-Q1H：Under the banquet operational timing protocol for the main state dinner gala hall, Bremenhaven Atlantic Forum achieves an average banquet table turnover speed of 45 min to reconfigure meal courses for 800 delegates.
HOM-BANQ-UBZ：Based on banquet operational timing protocols for the main state dinner gala hall, the banquet table turnover speed for Weser Estuary Exhibition Complex averages 35 min to reconfigure meal courses for 800 delegates.
